verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם חָלָ֥ה חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לָמ֑וּת וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵ֠לָיו יְשַׁעְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֜וֹץ הַנָּבִ֗יא וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ צַ֣ו לְבֵיתֶ֔ךָ כִּ֛י מֵ֥ת אַתָּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm ḥā·lāh ḥiz·qî·yā·hū lā·mūṯ way·yā·ḇō ’ê·lāw yə·ša‘·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wṣ han·nā·ḇî way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣaw lə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā kî mêṯ ’at·tāh wə·lō ṯiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz came to him and said This is what the LORD says Put your house in order for you are about to die you will not recover
verses.literalPt: NAQUELES dias adoeceu Ezequias mortalmente; e o profeta Isaías, filho de Amós, veio a ele e lhe disse: Assim diz o SENHOR: Põe em ordem a tua casa, porque morrerás, e não viverás.

verses.original: וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־ פָּנָ֖יו אֶל־ הַקִּ֑יר וַיִּ֨תְפַּלֵּ֔ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yas·sêḇ ’eṯ- pā·nāw ’el- haq·qîr way·yiṯ·pal·lêl ’el- Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD saying
verses.literalPt: Então virou o rosto para a parede, e orou ao SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: אָנָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה זְכָר־ נָ֞א אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לְפָנֶ֗יךָ בֶּֽאֱמֶת֙ וּבְלֵבָ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם וְהַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכִ֥י גָדֽוֹל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ān·nāh Yah·weh zə·ḵār- nā ’êṯ ’ă·šer hiṯ·hal·laḵ·tî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā be·’ĕ·meṯ ū·ḇə·lê·ḇāḇ šā·lêm wə·haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ‘ā·śî·ṯî way·yê·ḇək ḥiz·qî·yā·hū bə·ḵî ḡā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: Please O LORD remember . . . how I have walked before You faithfully and with wholehearted devotion I have done what is good in Your sight And Hezekiah . . . wept bitterly
verses.literalPt: Ah, SENHOR! Suplico-te lembrar de que andei diante de ti em verdade, com o coração perfeito, e fiz o que era bom aos teus olhos. E chorou Ezequias muitíssimo.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ לֹ֣א יָצָ֔א הָעִיר הַתִּֽיכֹנָ֑ה וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה הָיָ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî yə·ša‘·yā·hū lō yā·ṣā hå̄·ʿīr hat·tî·ḵō·nāh ū·ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh ’ê·lāw lê·mōr
verses.literal: Before Isaiah had left the middle courtyard the word of the LORD came to him saying
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, pois, que, não havendo Isaías ainda saído do meio do pátio, veio a ele a palavra do SENHOR dizendo:

verses.original: שׁ֣וּב וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ נְגִיד־ עַמִּ֗י כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔יךָ שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶת־ תְּפִלָּתֶ֔ךָ רָאִ֖יתִי אֶת־ דִּמְעָתֶ֑ךָ הִנְנִי֙ רֹ֣פֶא לָ֔ךְ בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י תַּעֲלֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šūḇ wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- ḥiz·qî·yā·hū nə·ḡîḏ- ‘am·mî kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā šā·ma‘·tî ’eṯ- tə·p̄il·lā·ṯe·ḵā rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- dim·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā hin·nî rō·p̄e lāḵ bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî ta·‘ă·leh bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Go back and tell . . . Hezekiah the leader of My people that this is what the LORD the God of your father David says I have heard your prayer I have seen your tears I will surely heal you On the third day from now you will go up to the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Volta, e dize a Ezequias, capitão do meu povo: Assim diz o SENHOR, o Deus de Davi, teu pai: Ouvi a tua oração, e vi as tuas lágrimas; eis que eu te sararei; ao terceiro dia subirás à casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהֹסַפְתִּ֣י עַל־ יָמֶ֗יךָ חֲמֵ֤שׁ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּמִכַּ֤ף מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ אַצִּ֣ילְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וְגַנּוֹתִי֙ עַל־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את לְמַֽעֲנִ֔י וּלְמַ֖עַן דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·sap̄·tî ‘al- yā·me·ḵā ḥă·mêš ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh ū·mik·kap̄ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr ’aṣ·ṣî·lə·ḵā wə·’êṯ hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·ḡan·nō·w·ṯî ‘al- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ lə·ma·‘ă·nî ū·lə·ma·‘an dā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî
verses.literal: I will add fifteen . . . years to your life And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria I will defend . . . this city for My sake and for the sake of My servant David
verses.literalPt: E acrescentarei aos teus dias quinze anos, e das mãos do rei da Assíria te livrarei, a ti e a esta cidade; e ampararei esta cidade por amor de mim, e por amor de Davi, meu servo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ קְח֖וּ דְּבֶ֣לֶת תְּאֵנִ֑ים וַיִּקְח֛וּ וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ עַֽל־ הַשְּׁחִ֖ין וַיֶּֽחִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·ša‘·yā·hū qə·ḥū də·ḇe·leṯ tə·’ê·nîm way·yiq·ḥū way·yā·śî·mū ‘al- haš·šə·ḥîn way·ye·ḥî
verses.literal: Then Isaiah said Prepare a poultice of figs So they brought it and applied it to the boil and Hezekiah recovered
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Isaías: Tomai uma pasta de figos. E a tomaram, e a puseram sobre a chaga; e ele sarou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶֽל־ יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ מָ֣ה א֔וֹת כִּֽי־ יִרְפָּ֥א יְהוָ֖ה לִ֑י וְעָלִ֛יתִי בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖י בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ’el- yə·ša‘·yā·hū māh ’ō·wṯ kî- yir·pā Yah·weh lî wə·‘ā·lî·ṯî bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now Hezekiah . . . had asked Isaiah What will be the sign that the LORD will heal me and that I will go up to the house of the LORD on the third day
verses.literalPt: E Ezequias disse a Isaías: Qual é o sinal de que o SENHOR me sarará, e de que ao terceiro dia subirei à casa do SENHOR?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְשַׁעְיָ֗הוּ זֶה־ לְּךָ֤ הָאוֹת֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֚י יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר הָלַ֤ךְ הַצֵּל֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר מַֽעֲל֔וֹת אִם־ יָשׁ֖וּב עֶ֥שֶׂר מַעֲלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·ša‘·yā·hū zeh- lə·ḵā hā·’ō·wṯ mê·’êṯ Yah·weh kî ya·‘ă·śeh Yah·weh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·bêr hā·laḵ haṣ·ṣêl ‘e·śer ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’im- yā·šūḇ ‘e·śer ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: And Isaiah had replied This will be a sign to you from the LORD that He - will do what He has promised Would you like the shadow to go forward ten steps or back ten steps
verses.literalPt: Disse Isaías: Isto te será sinal, da parte do SENHOR, de que o SENHOR cumprirá a palavra que disse: Adiantar-se-á a sombra dez graus, ou voltará dez graus atrás?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ נָקֵ֣ל לַצֵּ֔ל לִנְט֖וֹת עֶ֣שֶׂר מַעֲל֑וֹת לֹ֣א כִ֔י יָשׁ֥וּב הַצֵּ֛ל אֲחֹרַנִּ֖ית עֶ֥שֶׂר מַעֲלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū nā·qêl laṣ·ṣêl lin·ṭō·wṯ ‘e·śer ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ lō ḵî yā·šūḇ haṣ·ṣêl ’ă·ḥō·ran·nîṯ ‘e·śer ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: It is easy for the shadow to lengthen ten steps answered Hezekiah but not . . . for it to go back ten steps
verses.literalPt: Então disse Ezequias: É fácil que a sombra decline dez graus; não seja assim, mas volte a sombra dez graus atrás.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א יְשַׁעְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּ֣שֶׁב אֶת־ הַצֵּ֗ל בַּֽ֠מַּעֲלוֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרְדָ֜ה בְּמַעֲל֥וֹת אָחָ֛ז אֲחֹֽרַנִּ֖ית עֶ֥שֶׂר מַעֲלֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā yə·ša‘·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî ’el- Yah·weh way·yā·šeḇ ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣêl bam·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’ă·šer yā·rə·ḏāh bə·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’ā·ḥāz ’ă·ḥō·ran·nîṯ ‘e·śer ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: So Isaiah the prophet called out to the LORD and He brought the shadow . . . back the ten steps it had descended on the stairway of Ahaz
verses.literalPt: Então o profeta Isaías clamou ao SENHOR; e fez voltar a sombra dez graus atrás, pelos graus que tinha declinado no relógio de sol de Acaz.

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֡יא שָׁלַ֡ח בְּרֹאדַ֣ךְ בַּ֠לְאֲדָן בֶּֽן־ בַּלְאֲדָ֧ן מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל סְפָרִ֥ים וּמִנְחָ֖ה אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע כִּ֥י חָלָ֖ה חִזְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·‘êṯ ha·hî šā·laḥ bə·rō·ḏaḵ bal·’ă·ḏān ben- bal·’ă·ḏān me·leḵ- bā·ḇel sə·p̄ā·rîm ū·min·ḥāh ’el- ḥiz·qî·yā·hū kî šā·ma‘ kî ḥā·lāh ḥiz·qî·yā·hū
verses.literal: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah for he had heard about Hezekiah’s illness
verses.literalPt: Naquele tempo enviou Berodaque-Baladã, filho de Baladã, rei de Babilônia, cartas e um presente a Ezequias; porque ouvira que Ezequias tinha estado doente.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע עֲלֵיהֶם֮ חִזְקִיָּהוּ֒ וַיַּרְאֵ֣ם אֶת־ כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית נְכֹתֹ֡ה אֶת־ הַכֶּסֶף֩ וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָ֨ב וְאֶת־ הַבְּשָׂמִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַטּ֗וֹב וְאֵת֙ בֵּ֣ית כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִמְצָ֖א בְּאֽוֹצְרֹתָ֑יו לֹֽא־ הָיָ֣ה דָבָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־ הֶרְאָ֧ם חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ בְּבֵית֖וֹ וּבְכָל־ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ‘ă·lê·hem ḥiz·qî·yā·hū way·yar·’êm ’eṯ- kāl- bêṯ nə·ḵō·ṯōh ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- hab·bə·śā·mîm wə·’êṯ še·men haṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·’êṯ bêṯ kê·lāw wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer nim·ṣā bə·’ō·wṣ·rō·ṯāw lō- hā·yāh ḏā·ḇār ’ă·šer lō- her·’ām ḥiz·qî·yā·hū bə·ḇê·ṯōw ū·ḇə·ḵāl mem·šal·tōw
verses.literal: And Hezekiah received the envoys and showed them all that was in his treasure house the silver the gold the spices and the precious oil as well as his armory . . . all that was found in his storehouses There was nothing . . . in his palace or in all his dominion that Hezekiah did not show them
verses.literalPt: E Ezequias lhes deu ouvidos; e lhes mostrou toda a casa de seu tesouro, a prata, o ouro, as especiarias e os melhores ungüentos, e a sua casa de armas, e tudo quanto se achou nos seus tesouros; coisa nenhuma houve que não lhes mostrasse, nem em sua casa, nem em todo o seu domínio.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֶל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו מָ֥ה אָמְר֣וּ׀ הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וּמֵאַ֙יִן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ מֵאֶ֧רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֛ה בָּ֖אוּ מִבָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yə·ša‘·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî ’el- ham·me·leḵ ḥiz·qî·yā·hū way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw māh ’ā·mə·rū hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh ū·mê·’a·yin yā·ḇō·’ū ’ê·le·ḵā way·yō·mer ḥiz·qî·yā·hū mê·’e·reṣ rə·ḥō·w·qāh bā·’ū mib·bā·ḇel
verses.literal: Then the prophet Isaiah went to King Hezekiah and asked Where did those men come from . . . and what did they say to you They came from a distant land Hezekiah replied from Babylon
verses.literalPt: Então o profeta Isaías veio ao rei Ezequias, e lhe disse: Que disseram aqueles homens, e de onde vieram a ti? Disse Ezequias: Vieram de um país muito remoto, de Babilônia.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֥ה רָא֖וּ בְּבֵיתֶ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּבֵיתִי֙ רָא֔וּ לֹא־ הָיָ֥ה דָבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ הִרְאִיתִ֖ם בְּאֹצְרֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer māh rā·’ū bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā way·yō·mer ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer bə·ḇê·ṯî rā·’ū lō- hā·yāh ḏā·ḇār ’ă·šer lō- hir·’î·ṯim bə·’ō·ṣə·rō·ṯāy
verses.literal: What have they seen in your palace Isaiah asked They have seen everything in my palace answered Hezekiah There is nothing . . . among my treasures that I did not show them
verses.literalPt: E disse ele: Que viram em tua casa? E disse Ezequias: Tudo quanto há em minha casa viram; coisa nenhuma há nos meus tesouros que eu não lhes mostrasse.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְשַׁעְיָ֖הוּ אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ שְׁמַ֖ע דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·ša‘·yā·hū ’el- ḥiz·qî·yā·hū šə·ma‘ də·ḇar- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah Hear the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então disse Isaías a Ezequias: Ouve a palavra do SENHOR.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֮ יָמִ֣ים בָּאִים֒ וְנִשָּׂ֣א׀ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּבֵיתֶ֗ךָ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר אָצְר֧וּ אֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ עַד־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה בָּבֶ֑לָה לֹֽא־ יִוָּתֵ֥ר דָּבָ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm wə·niś·śā kāl- ’ă·šer bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā wa·’ă·šer ’ā·ṣə·rū ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh bā·ḇe·lāh lō- yiw·wā·ṯêr dā·ḇār ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: The time will surely come when everything in your palace and all that your fathers have stored up until this day will be carried off to Babylon Nothing . . . will be left says the LORD
verses.literalPt: Eis que vêm dias em que tudo quanto houver em tua casa, e o que entesouraram teus pais até ao dia de hoje, será levado a Babilônia; não ficará coisa alguma, disse o SENHOR.

verses.original: וּמִבָּנֶ֜יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵצְא֧וּ מִמְּךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תּוֹלִ֖יד יִקָּח וְהָיוּ֙ סָֽרִיסִ֔ים בְּהֵיכַ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bā·ne·ḵā ’ă·šer yê·ṣə·’ū mim·mə·ḵā ’ă·šer tō·w·lîḏ yiq·qå̄ḥ wə·hā·yū sā·rî·sîm bə·hê·ḵal me·leḵ bā·ḇel
verses.literal: And some of - your descendants your own flesh and blood will be taken away to be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon
verses.literalPt: E ainda até de teus filhos, que procederem de ti, e que tu gerares, tomarão, para que sejam eunucos no paço do rei da Babilônia.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶֽל־ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ ט֥וֹב דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֑רְתָּ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הֲל֛וֹא אִם־ שָׁל֥וֹם וֶאֱמֶ֖ת יִהְיֶ֥ה בְיָמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ’el- yə·ša‘·yā·hū ṭō·wḇ də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·bar·tā way·yō·mer hă·lō·w ’im- šā·lō·wm we·’ĕ·meṯ yih·yeh ḇə·yā·māy
verses.literal: But Hezekiah said to Isaiah The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good For he thought Will there not at least be peace and security in my lifetime
verses.literalPt: Então disse Ezequias a Isaías: Boa é a palavra do SENHOR que disseste. Disse mais: E não haverá, pois, em meus dias paz e verdade?

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י חִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וְכָל־ גְּב֣וּרָת֔וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה אֶת־ הַבְּרֵכָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַתְּעָלָ֔ה וַיָּבֵ֥א אֶת־ הַמַּ֖יִם הָעִ֑ירָה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ḥiz·qî·yā·hū wə·ḵāl gə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw wa·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- hab·bə·rê·ḵāh wə·’eṯ- hat·tə·‘ā·lāh way·yā·ḇê ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim hā·‘î·rāh hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Hezekiah along with all his might and how he constructed the pool and the tunnel to bring water into the city . . . . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah
verses.literalPt: Ora, o mais dos atos de Ezequias, e todo o seu poder, e como fez a piscina e o aqueduto, e como fez vir a água à cidade, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yim·lōḵ mə·naš·šeh ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Hezekiah rested with his fathers and his son Manasseh reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E Ezequias dormiu com seus pais; e Manassés, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
